content.title: What is Solidus AI Tech about?
content.description: Solidus AI Tech has built one of the first Web3 AI infrastructure powered by a state-of-the-art, eco-friendly High-Performance Computing (HPC) data center in Europe. The $AITECH token fuels an ecosystem of products that bridge AI utility, scalable compute, and Web3-native tooling - empowering developers, enterprises, and institutions to build, deploy, and scale AI solutions seamlessly.

content.title: About Monad
content.description: Monad is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain that processes 10,000 transactions per second with near-zero fees while maintaining complete compatibility with the Ethereum Virtual Machine.

content.title: About Pi Network (PI)
content.description: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency and developer platform designed to make digital currency mining accessible to everyday people through mobile devices.

content.title: What is Hyperliquid about?
content.description: Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship DEX trading platform, the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, real world assets (RWAs), and a full-fledged Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), making it a leading force in decentralized finance (defi).

content.title: What is Aave?
content.description: Aave is a decentralized money market protocol where users can lend and borrow cryptocurrency across 20 different assets as collateral.

content.title: About Optimism (OP)
content.description: OP is the token for the Optimism Collective that governs the Optimism L2 blockchain. The Optimism Collective is a large-scale experiment in digital democratic governance, built to drive rapid and sustainable growth of a decentralized ecosystem, and stewarded by the newly formed Optimism Foundation. OP governs upgrades to the protocol and network parameters, and creates an ongoing system of incentives for projects and users in the Optimism ecosystem. 5.4% of the total token supply will be distributed to projects on Optimism over the next six months via governance. If you're building something in the Ethereum ecosystem, you can consider applying for the grant.

content.title: What is Plume about?
content.description: Plume is the first RWAfi L1 network focused on crypto natives, building infrastructure to connect the real world and crypto markets. It challenges the traditional view of RWAs by introducing new, crypto-first RWA use cases, including RWA derivatives, speculation, borrowing, lending, yield farming, and more, rather than simply replicating traditional finance on the blockchain.

content.title: About Asteroid Shiba
content.description: Asteroid Shiba is inspired by a real-life event where a Shiba Inu plush toy named "Asteroid" served as a zero-gravity indicator during the Polaris Dawn mission. This connection to space travel gives it a narrative that's both whimsical and grounded in a tangible event, differentiating it from other meme coins which might rely solely on internet culture or celebrity endorsements.
